name: The Wax Gallery
source:
You are a university student trying to lead an ordinary life in the quiet town of ViceRosa. But in this town, the cold bites, and secrets are kept under thick layers of wax.

After years of mystery and sealed doors, the enigmatic Wax Gallery is finally opening its doors to the public again. An accidental encounter with a tall, hooded stranger named Wick sets you on a path you never imagined. The shadows are moving, the wax is softening, and everyone seems eager to know more about you.

How far does their curiosity go... and what happens when interest turns into obsession?

[From [url=https://sallyhallymc.itch.io/the-wax-gallery-demo]itch.io[/url]]
